meta.title: Pianist – Learn Piano with Your MIDI Keyboard | Free & Open Source
meta.description: Learn piano with your MIDI keyboard: falling notes, sheet music and chord hints. Pianist waits until you hit the right key. Free, open source, in your browser.
meta.ogImageAlt: Pianist: glowing falling notes land on a piano keyboard, sparks fly on a correct note.
meta.keywords: learn piano, MIDI keyboard, piano app, falling notes, sheet music, chords, open source

hero.kicker: Learn piano with your MIDI keyboard · free & open source
hero.lead: Pianist turns your MIDI keyboard into a lit stage. Notes fall, time waits until you hit the right key, and every hit throws sparks.

descent.label: From the stage to the keys

steps.t: Every piece becomes a stage. Load any MIDI file or start with the demo.
Notes fall in glowing lanes, one per key. Blue is the right hand, orange the left.
They land exactly on the key you play. Beginner beams show where the next note lands.
Every note you hit throws sparks. The harder you play, the brighter they get.

wait.title: Time waits for you.
wait.lead: The music stops on every note until you play it. The left hand plays along for you. Try it: click the glowing key or use your computer keyboard.
wait.keysHint: Letters on the keys = your computer keyboard

perf.title: Or keep time, for real.
perf.lead: In real time, every hit counts to the millisecond: Perfect within ±50 ms, Good within ±120 ms. Press Space, any key, or tap the lane when the note lands.

harmony.title: Which chord comes next?
harmony.lead: Play a chord. Pianist names it, finds the key, and suggests what fits next, with Roman numerals and ghost notes on the keys.
harmony.latch: Keys stay down when clicked. Click again to release.

notation.title: Falling notes or sheet music. Or both.
notation.lead: The same piece as real notation, with a cursor that runs along and lights up every sounding note.

quant.title: Play it loose. Get it clean.
quant.lead: Record what you play. The quantizer snaps it to the grid you choose, with triplets, swing and hands kept apart. Then export it.
quant.formats: Exports MIDI, MusicXML, SVG and PNG

rig.title: Everything else you need to practice.

items.d: Web MIDI with hot-plug, velocity and sustain pedal. No driver, no install.
Play with your computer keys or the mouse. The app works the same.
Tempo 25–150 %, loop any bars, metronome, count-in and auto-tempo.
Pieces and recordings stay in your browser, with progress and best accuracy.
Color-blind-safe colors, symbols on every judgement, reduced motion respected.
Every line of code is public on GitHub. Read it, fork it, make it better.

finale.title: Now it’s your turn.
finale.lead: All 88 keys. Play them here, or bring your own piano.
finale.note: Free, no sign-up. Runs in Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Brave.
